series.title: Classic Series
series.tagline: Everyday washdown, hot water, food-grade and hazardous areas
series.intro: The Classic Series is our everyday washdown range. It starts with solid brass all-rounders in six colours and extends to insulated hot-wash guns, large-bore outlets for lances and foam, FDA-compliant stainless for food processing, autoclave-sterilisable models and ATEX-rated guns for hazardous areas.

series.title: Premium Series
series.tagline: Blue King, Blue Princess and Baby: water-saving and compact
series.intro: Our premium guns are built to save water and suit the hand. The Blue King and Blue Princess use at least 16% and 26% less water, with soft-touch grips and drip-free nozzles. The Baby Series is a compact rear-trigger gun sized for smaller hands.

series.title: Specialty Guns
series.intro: Guns for jobs outside standard hose-down: an air-boosted water gun that delivers high impact with very little water, and a compact trigger gun for occasional industrial use.

series.title: Twistflow Series
series.intro: Twistflow heads open, close and shape the jet with a simple twist, with no trigger to hold. The range runs from water-saving heads for long cleaning jobs up to high-flow sprayers for trucks, ships, tanks and sites, plus rubber-covered handles for comfortable long use.

series.title: Shower Head Series
series.intro: Shower heads give a soft, even wash for meat, fish, vegetables and other delicate produce. Choose a hand shower, or The Squeezer self-closing valve with a shower head fitted.

series.title: Accessories
series.tagline: Parts and add-ons for your washdown guns
series.intro: Parts and add-ons to get the most out of your washdown guns. Contact our team for the full accessory list.
